The '''Advanced sensory implant''' enhanced the sensory-interpretation areas of the brain, thereby heightening the user's awareness and analysis of their surroundings, as well as spatial perception. It augmented the mind's natural ability to process visual data, enhancing the user's ability to perceive targets under difficult conditions.
